title: Featured Open Source Projects
description: A curated selection of public repositories maintained by ARG Software.

projects.name: Chrome-Extension-ReactVite-Boilerplate
projects.description: A boilerplate for building Chrome extensions with React, TypeScript, and Vite that is fast, modular, and ready to customize.

projects.name: Clean-Architecture
projects.description: A pragmatic Clean Architecture template for scalable, testable, and maintainable software.

projects.name: Angular-Redux

projects.name: Kubernetes-Poc
